principles.statement: Conversation context remains byte-stable except for explicit compression.
principles.rationale: Prompt-cache reuse is a core cost and correctness invariant.
principles.enforcement: Tests and review reject mid-conversation system prompt or tool-schema mutation.

principles.statement: New capability uses the least permanent core footprint that solves the need.
principles.rationale: Every core tool schema is paid on every model request.
principles.enforcement: Review applies the footprint ladder before accepting new core surface.

principles.statement: Changes are proven through behavior contracts and representative end-to-end paths.
principles.rationale: Mocks alone hide resolution, configuration, security, and I/O failures.
principles.enforcement: Task verification includes focused regression tests and relevant integration smoke.

principles.statement: Profiles remain independent runtime and configuration islands.
principles.rationale: Implicit inheritance creates hidden coupling and cross-profile regressions.
principles.enforcement: Profile-aware paths use the active HERMES_HOME and tests cover isolation.
